valid_holdout_dti.reason: No promotion-grade HOLDOUT-DTI is available. Historical records include quadrant folds that can split connected faults, an unversioned local evaluator that has not been reconciled with the authorized shared evaluator, a score-conditioned random arm in the older record, and fold-level intervals rather than uncertainty from pooled-score contributions. No experiment was rerun in this review; the recorded three-experiment budget is exhausted.

historical_holdout_dti.protocol: Quadrant holdout; a connected fault may cross a fold boundary.
historical_holdout_dti.control_limitation: The nominal random arm was conditioned on score > 0, so it was not uniform over eligible pixels.
historical_holdout_dti.ci_limitation: Four-fold bootstrap interval over fold DTI values; not pooled-score contribution uncertainty.

historical_holdout_dti.protocol: Five whole-segment/lattice folds with a 3 px buffer; visible catalogue pixels masked per fold; component totals pooled before the ratio, as recorded in the source run.
historical_holdout_dti.ci_limitation: 95% intervals bootstrap the five fold DTI values, not pooled-score contributions; evaluator is local and not authorized/shared.
historical_holdout_dti.promotion_conclusion: The stored candidate did not beat the stored one-scale comparator; neither result is valid promotion evidence.
